units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 4:1">Tam. IV, 1</cite> <he>לא היו כוֹפְתִין וכ׳</he> they did not twist (tie together the four feet of) the lamb, opp. <cite ref="P01153"><he>העקיד</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P01153"><he>עָקַד</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 70b:2">Snh. 70ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 31:1">Prov. XXXI, 1</cite>) <he>שכְּפָתתּוֹ אמו וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שכפאתו</he>) his mother tied him to a post; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>כפפתו</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 3:9">Par. III, 9</cite> <he>כְּפָתוּהָ וכ׳</he> they tied her (the red heifer) with a rope &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56">Gen. R. s. 56</cite> <he>כל מה … עוקד … כופת וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="K00198"><he>כובש</he></cite>) as much as Abraham bound Isaac …, the Lord tied (held in check) the genii of the gentiles; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 101:1">Yalk. Gen. 101</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 561:2">Yalk. Nah. 561</cite>. Gen. R. l. c. <he>כְּפָתֵנִי וכ׳</he> tie me well.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:12">Macc. III, 12</cite> <he>כופת שתי ידיו וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="K00336"><he>כופה</he></cite>) one puts both his hands in stocks on the pole.
<cite ref="Gittin 14b:4">Gitt. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>אומרין כְּפוֹתוּ כּוֹפְתִין</he> when they (the officers) say, put him in stocks, they put him &c.

<cite ref="Sukkah 32a:12">Succ. 32ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>כפת</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 23:40">Lev. XXIII, 40</cite>) <he>כָּפוּת אם היה פרוד יִכְפְּתֶנּוּ</he> (Ms. M. omits <cite ref="K01003"><he>כפות</he></cite>) it must be tied; if the branch is spread, one must tie it closely.
<cite ref="Leviticus 23:40">Ib.</cite> <he>כָּפוּת מכלל וכ׳</he> ‘tied’ implies that it is sometimes spread, while this (the stalk) is always tied (closely pressed together).
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 7:5">Toh. VII, 5</cite> <he>אפי׳ כפות</he>, v. <cite ref="J00048"><he>יָבַל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:5:6">Y. Gitt. I, end, 43ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:4:7">Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ויוסי אחי כ׳ וכ׳</he> and (I saw) my brother J. in stocks and the lash passing over him.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 2:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. II, 3</cite> (ref. to ‘their bands’, <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 2:5">ib.</cite>) <he>אלו שבע מצות שהן כְּפוּתִין בהן</he> (not <he>כתופין כתיפ׳</he>, v. ed. Bub. note) those are the seven (Noachidic) laws by which they (the gentiles) are tied (restrained); a. e.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 1</cite>. Y. Hor. III, 48ᵇ bot. <he>מְכַפֵּת</he>, v. <cite ref="K01043"><he>כָּפַף</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְכוּפָּת</he>, pl. <he>מְכוּפָּתִין</he>.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:7">Esth. R. to I, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="K01065"><he>כְּפָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:14">Cant. R. to. I, 14</cite>.
